definition: קִיקָיוֺן noun masculine Jonah 4:6 a plant (compare Assyrian Kukkânîtum ( כ ) a garden-plant, Dl HWB 327 ); — usually ricinus (R. communis , Linn . = castor-oil tree ; compare Dioscor iv. 164 κίκι (Egypt) = κρότων [ castor-oil tree ]; Talmud שֶׁמֶן קִיק see especially Löw p. 353 f. ); perhaps < bottle-gourd ( ᵐ5 κολόκυνθα ; i.e. cucurbita lagenaria , a vine growing and withering rapidly, Post in Hastings DB ii. 250 ); — Jonah 4:6 (twice in verse); Jonah 4:7 ; Jonah 4:9 ; Jonah 4:10 . קִיקָלוֺן see קלל .
